## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass locally
- [ ] Cursor review completed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or hardcoded env values added
- [ ] Base branch is correct:
  - feature work → **`develop`**
  - release (from `develop` only) → **`main`**

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for branching, smoke vs regression, and tagging.
